title: Missing Origin-Agent-Cluster response header
description: The response omits Origin-Agent-Cluster. The header asks the browser to place the document in an origin-keyed agent cluster instead of the default site-keyed one, which narrows the state a same-site cross-origin document can share. Absence keeps the default, so the page loses an isolation hint rather than a protection it previously had.
remediation: Send Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?1 on documents that tolerate origin-keyed isolation, and verify that same-site frames still work. Leave the default where a same-site frame relies on synchronous access.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot tell whether the page depends on site-keyed synchrony, and browser handling of the hint still varies.
